test_case_name: Accept all cookies and verify banner closure on child page

intents.intent: Click 'Acconsento' button to accept all cookies
And then check that the cookie banner is no longer visible

test_case_name: Access cookie options from child page and verify navigation

intents.intent: Click 'Più opzioni' link to open cookie options
And then check that the cookie options page is displayed

intents.intent: Click 'Passa al Contenuto' button to skip to main content
And then check that the focus is set to the main content area

And then check that the focus is set to the main menu area

test_case_name: Skip to footer using accessibility button on child page

test_case_name: Open search bar and perform a search on child page

intents.intent: Click 'Search' button to open the search bar
Type $name into 'Cosa posso fare per te oggi?' input field
Click search button with class 'btn-search' to submit the search
And then check that the search results are displayed

test_case_name: Reset search input on child page

intents.intent: Click 'Search' button to open the search bar
Type $name into 'Cosa posso fare per te oggi?' input field
Click reset button with class 'btn-reset-search' to clear the search input
And then check that the search input field is empty

test_case_name: Perform a mobile search on child page

intents.intent: Type $name into 'Cerca' input field
Click search button with class 'btn-search' to submit the mobile search
And then check that the search results are displayed

test_case_name: Login as guest on child page with remember me option

intents.intent: Type $email into 'E-mail' input field
Type $name into 'Password' input field
Click 'Mantieni L'accesso' checkbox to enable remember me
Click 'ENTRA' button to submit login
And then check that the user is logged in as guest

intents.intent: Click 'Recupera Password' link to start password recovery
